text_block_list.text:
A TV shoot I was invited to alongside the Umamusume of the Symboli family.
The theme, of course, was—

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"Overseas Expeditions"... Speed Symboli-san,
how do you look back on your own?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It was a tremendous experience.
Both for myself and for the generations that followed.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well, but back then, it was really tough.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Speed Symboli! Speed Symboli! That makes it an unstoppable four-race winning streak! Speed Symboli!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I remember it well, too.
Your rock-solid presence domestically, and—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how terribly emaciated she was right after returning home.
To me, that sight alone was shocking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Agreed—the world is high... and steep.

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text: The shock... Perhaps it's because I'm watching from so close up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. An Umamusume stronger—and tougher than her—is rare.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, you achieved consecutive victories in the Arima Kinen.
Precisely because you were the strongest domestically...
it made the height of the world's wall all the more apparent, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So that's how the "Emperor"
worries over the state of the world, does she.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "If anything, I was having a blast finding interesting stuff."

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Something interesting...?
Um, what on earth could that be...?
With nearly everyone, including the spectators in the stands, tilting their heads in confusion, I pondered it myself.
In the face of Speed Symboli's legend, the barrier of overseas competition became all the clearer... and yet.
choice_data_list: (Legends mean nothing in front of Sirius Symboli)

text_block_list.text:
—At that moment, I suddenly remembered.
On the day I met these members in the student council room,
she had definitely said something like this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —The world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna take the world. In the world's skies where no one has ever claimed victory before, I'll shine."

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
The world... you say?

That's right... In this moment, she found it.
Something worthy of her—
choice_data_list: A sky worthy of the brightest star shining above.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes... it is precisely in the night of despair
that the stars shine brightest. And—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That brilliance would eventually ascend to legend.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Brighter than the Emperor, brighter than legend.
Way, way brighter.

text_block_list.name: Studio Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I see.
I must admire your audacity. However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are not the only star.
I, too, am determined to shine brilliantly
as a star of hope for all Japanese Umamusume.

I look straight into the "Emperor's" eyes.
And with a smile, as if spurred on by her unwavering confidence.
choice_data_list: The brightest star in the night sky is "Sirius."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh—is that right?

text_block_list.name: Studio Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Oooh!)

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
What... what a thrilling thing to say!
It took my breath away for a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text: For an Umamusume, wouldn't you say these are the ultimate words of praise?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
—Dazzlingly so.
